items.text: Tag cloud (/) — optional FAB on desktop opens a word cloud of all tags (size = usage, # on every tag). Toggle under Config → General → Header & Buttons; on by default.
/ shortcut — on the dashboard (search closed), / opens the tag cloud when enabled; otherwise / keeps fuzzy/interleave search.
Keyboard in the modal — arrows move between tags and Clear tag filter; Enter applies; Escape closes; clearing restores focus to the selected bookmark.
Tag filter view — pick a tag to see only matching bookmarks in an animated temporary layout; Escape clears when the modal is closed.
Corner FAB stack — tag cloud sits directly above What's new; launcher moves up when the tag cloud is on.
:tag browse — :tag lists tags; :tag work or :tag:work shows matching bookmarks in the palette only (dashboard unchanged).
:tag +name / :tag -name — add or remove a tag on the keyboard-selected bookmark.
